## Checks

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes. A line that starts with `skipped:` is expected in the public copy.
- [ ] A data change has a public source link in the row.
- [ ] A new check has a taxonomy row, a label, a fixture example and an `expect` entry.
- [ ] `README.md` counts are updated if a rule, clause, tracker, outlet or fixture page was added or removed.
- [ ] `PRIVACY.md` and the README Privacy section are updated if the change sends anything new out of the browser.
- [ ] No recorded or saved copy of a third-party page or response is included.
- [ ] No personal data, API key, password or personal file path is included.
